longTitle: A Bill to transfer the ownership and management of Monken Hadley Common to Monken Hadley Common Trust and for related purposes.
petitioningPeriod:
17 June 2021 to 28 June 2021.

No petitions were submitted during the petitioning period.
petitionInformation:
The petitioning period in the House of Commons ran from 22 January 2020 to 30 January 2020. No petitions against the Bill were received in the Commons.

The Lords petitioning period runs up until 5pm on Monday 28 June 2021.

Guidance on petitioning in the Lords can be found here:

How to petition against a private bill - UK Parliament
